interpretation: Retrospective diagnostic only; no automatic forecast gate promotion or allocation selection. Fixed current-survivor stock basket, retrospectively fitted stock weights, revised macro data and Treasury return proxies remain limitations.
prior_units: Annual prior mean divided by 12 and covariance divided by 12 under iid monthly scaling; NIW strength parameters unchanged. This is a new monthly model, not validation of the annual model.
pre_freeze_inspection: Historical annual outcomes and monthly feasibility already inspected; one representative dynamic fit checked for convergence before freezing. No full monthly range score table inspected before freeze.
